author: SKIZZOO
name: JuiceVault
description: Continuously plays audio from JuiceVault's Music archive in a Discord voice channel and loops the archive.
install_msg: No system-wide FFmpeg install is required: this cog uses imageio-ffmpeg to provide FFmpeg from the Python environment. PyNaCl and davey are required for Discord voice. Then use [p]jv start while you are in the target voice channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only the configured guild voice channel ID and enabled state. It does not store personal user data.
